Draws a Totem of Undying from your inventory or offhand to feed your equipped Cryptic Eye.

§6Immediate Wards§r
Consuming a totem instantly applies §aRegeneration II§r (45s), §eAbsorption II§r (5s), §6Fire Resistance§r (40s), and purges active debuffs without needing to hold the totem.

§6Vitality Progression§r
Every 5 totems consumed permanently adds §c+1 Max Health§r (+0.5 heart), stacking up to §c+10 Max Health§r (5 extra hearts) at 50 totems. Consuming all 50 unlocks the passive §6Be Totem§r spell.
